posts.zh:
dsh-plugin-mm-vision 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。通感编码器（Synesthesia Encoder）：调用视觉模型把图片翻译成紧凑的结构化空间文字（画布/元素/百分比坐标），让纯文本 LLM 获得像素级看图能力（`mm_vision` 工具）。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6c06f3e16da9a7179697.html
posts.en:
dsh-plugin-mm-vision is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Synesthesia Encoder for DSH: a vision model translates images into compact structured spatial text (canvas/elements/percentage coordinates), giving text-only LLMs pixel-level image understanding via the `mm_vision` tool.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6c06f3e16da9a7179697.html
